copy.curiosityHook: Trapped between corrupt officers hunting the camera and vengeful locals closing in, who can she rely on to help get the truth out alive?
copy.description: After rookie cop and Army veteran Alicia West inadvertently records corrupt fellow officers committing murder on her body camera, she becomes the target of both dirty police and vengeful criminals on the streets.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and suspenseful action thriller with sharp institutional danger and relentless street-level pursuit.
copy.whyWatch: Deon Taylor delivers a fast, hard-hitting crime thriller that turns a high-stakes evidence race into a relentless, tension-fueled fight for survival.

allowedMaterial: Alicia West is an Army veteran and rookie cop
Body cam captures corrupt cops committing murder
Dual pursuit by criminals seeking revenge and police covering up the footage
Teaming up with one willing community member
excludedMaterial: Identity of conspirators beyond corrupt cops
Ultimate fate of the body cam footage
Character deaths or late survival outcomes
